plain: The grandson of a man named Marone, linked to a UFO story in Italy around 1933, might be on the verge of revealing something, and an Italian UFO researcher named Penotti is said to be closely on that trail. The online UFO commentator known as UAPGerb says so, passing it on as something he has heard. If the grandson speaks, it could add a family witness to an old Italian case.
